groups.name: launcher
groups.label: Launcher
groups.says: Where the launcher is, which way it points, and how its two wheels throw.

groups.name: pollen
groups.label: Pollen and pieces
groups.says: The pollen that is launched, and the pieces on the field it may hit.

groups.name: field
groups.label: Field
groups.says: How the field is set up: whether either hive has been tipped.

groups.name: air
groups.label: Air
groups.says: The air the pollen flies through: how thick it is, and any wind.

groups.name: flight
groups.label: Flight model
groups.says: How the air acts on a flying pollen: drag slows it, spin lifts it or dips it, and the air slows the spin.

groups.name: bounce
groups.label: Bounce
groups.says: How a pollen bounces off each surface: how much speed it keeps, how hard the surface rubs on it, and how much of its spin springs back.

groups.name: contact
groups.label: Contact
groups.says: What every contact shares: how bounce falls off with speed, when a hit is too slow to bounce, and how a pollen that is touching something stops spinning and rolling.

groups.name: simulation
groups.label: Simulation
groups.says: How finely the shot is worked out, and for how long.

settings.name: x
settings.label: Launcher x
settings.says: Where the pollen leaves the wheels, measured from the centre of the field toward the far wall; the audience's side is negative.

settings.name: y
settings.label: Launcher y
settings.says: Where the pollen leaves the wheels, measured from the centre of the field toward red's wall; blue's side is negative.

settings.name: height
settings.label: Exit height
settings.says: How high above the floor the pollen's centre is as it leaves the wheels.

settings.name: yaw
settings.label: Yaw
settings.says: Which way the launcher points, turning left from the far wall: 90 points at red's wall, 180 at the audience and -90 at blue's wall.

settings.name: pitch
settings.label: Pitch
settings.says: How steeply the pollen is thrown: 0 is level, 90 is straight up and below 0 is downward.

settings.name: roll
settings.label: Roll
settings.says: Where wheel one sits around the pollen, turning about the way it is thrown: 0 puts it on top, 90 on the left and 180 underneath, and the spin the wheels give turns with it.

settings.name: wheel_one_rpm
settings.label: Wheel one speed
settings.says: How fast wheel one turns. With wheel one on top, a faster wheel one gives topspin, which dips the shot, and a slower one gives backspin, which lifts it.

settings.name: wheel_two_rpm
settings.label: Wheel two speed
settings.says: How fast wheel two, across the pollen from wheel one, turns. The pollen leaves at the two wheels' average surface speed and spins by their difference.

settings.name: wheel_one_diameter
settings.label: Wheel one diameter
settings.says: How big wheel one is across: a bigger wheel's surface moves faster at the same rpm.

settings.name: wheel_two_diameter
settings.label: Wheel two diameter
settings.says: How big wheel two is across: a bigger wheel's surface moves faster at the same rpm.

settings.name: ticks_per_rev
settings.label: Encoder ticks per turn
settings.says: How many encoder ticks a wheel's motor counts as its wheel turns once. It only changes what the form shows: each wheel's speed in ticks a second, as a motor's setVelocity takes it.

settings.name: speed_efficiency
settings.label: Speed efficiency
settings.says: How much of the wheels' average surface speed the pollen leaves with: 1 is all of it, and slip between the wheels and the pollen makes it less.

settings.name: spin_efficiency
settings.label: Spin efficiency
settings.says: How much of the spin the wheels' difference in speed would give the pollen it leaves with: 1 is all of it.

settings.name: compression
settings.label: Compression
settings.says: How much the wheels squeeze the pollen: the gap between them is its diameter less this. A tighter squeeze spins it faster for the same difference in wheel speed.

settings.name: wheels_slow
settings.label: Wheels slow down
settings.says: When on, each wheel loses some of its speed as it throws the pollen, as much as its inertia says, so the pollen leaves slower; when off, the wheels keep their speed.

settings.name: wheel_inertia
settings.label: Wheel inertia
settings.says: How hard each wheel, with its flywheel, is to slow down. It counts only when Wheels slow down is on: a heavier wheel loses less speed to the pollen.

settings.name: robot_vx
settings.label: Robot speed x
settings.says: How fast the robot is driving toward the far wall as it launches; the pollen leaves with the robot's speed added to its own.

settings.name: robot_vy
settings.label: Robot speed y
settings.says: How fast the robot is driving toward red's wall as it launches; the pollen leaves with the robot's speed added to its own.

settings.name: diameter
settings.label: Pollen diameter
settings.says: How big the launched pollen is across. A bigger ball meets more air, and the wheels spin it less for the same difference in their speeds.

settings.name: mass
settings.label: Pollen mass
settings.says: How heavy the launched pollen is: 24.9 g is 0.055 lb. The air slows a lighter ball more.

settings.name: inertia
settings.label: Pollen inertia
settings.says: How hard the pollen is to set spinning, as a share of its mass times its radius squared: a solid ball is 0.4 and a thin hollow shell 2/3, and the pollen's thick shell makes it 0.634.

settings.name: pieces
settings.label: Pieces on the field
settings.says: When on, the pollen and nectar where a match starts are on the field, and the launched pollen can hit them and knock them about; when off, the field is empty.

settings.name: nectar_mass
settings.label: Nectar mass
settings.says: How heavy each nectar on the field is: 41.3 g is 0.091 lb. A heavier one moves less when the pollen hits it.

settings.name: blue_hive_tipped
settings.label: Blue hive tipped
settings.says: When on, blue's hive is tipped the other way, so its other cell is the one that faces up and scores.

settings.name: red_hive_tipped
settings.label: Red hive tipped
settings.says: When on, red's hive is tipped the other way, so its other cell is the one that faces up and scores.

settings.name: temperature
settings.label: Temperature
settings.says: How warm the air is. Warmer air is thinner, so it holds the pollen back a little less.

settings.name: elevation
settings.label: Elevation
settings.says: How high above sea level the field is. The air is thinner higher up, so the pollen flies a little farther.

settings.name: humidity
settings.label: Humidity
settings.says: How damp the air is, as relative humidity. Damp air is a little thinner than dry air.

settings.name: wind_x
settings.label: Wind x
settings.says: How fast the air is moving toward the far wall, from a fan or a draught; it carries the pollen along with it.

settings.name: wind_y
settings.label: Wind y
settings.says: How fast the air is moving toward red's wall, from a fan or a draught; it carries the pollen along with it.

settings.name: drag
settings.label: Drag
settings.says: How hard the air holds the pollen back, as its drag coefficient when it is not spinning: 0.45 is a 26-hole pickleball's, measured in flight.

settings.name: drag_per_spin
settings.label: Drag per spin
settings.says: How much harder the air holds back a spinning pollen: the drag coefficient grows by this for each unit of spin, measured as how fast its surface turns over how fast it flies.

settings.name: lift_slope
settings.label: Lift slope
settings.says: How much lift a little spin makes: the lift coefficient for each unit of spin while the spin is small. Lift pushes a backspinning pollen up and a topspinning one down.

settings.name: lift_limit
settings.label: Lift limit
settings.says: The most lift spin can make, as a lift coefficient: lift grows with spin and levels off toward this.

settings.name: spin_down
settings.label: Spin-down
settings.says: How quickly the air slows the pollen's spin as it flies: the faster it flies, the sooner its spin dies away.

settings.name: added_mass
settings.label: Added mass
settings.says: How much of the air around the pollen it drags along, as a share of the air it pushes aside: 0.5 is a sphere's. It makes the ball a little harder to speed up or slow down.

settings.name: floor_bounce
settings.label: Floor bounce
settings.says: How much of its speed into the floor a pollen keeps as it bounces back, when it hits at 244 in/s: 1 keeps it all and 0 none, and a harder hit keeps a little less.

settings.name: floor_friction
settings.label: Floor friction
settings.says: How hard the floor rubs on a pollen sliding along it as they touch, as a friction coefficient: the harder the rub, the more of the slide turns into spin.

settings.name: floor_grip
settings.label: Floor grip
settings.says: How much of a pollen's slide and spin along the floor springs back the other way when the bounce grips: 0 leaves it rolling and 1 throws it all back.

settings.name: wall_bounce
settings.label: Wall bounce
settings.says: How much of its speed into a wall a pollen keeps as it bounces back, when it hits at 244 in/s: 1 keeps it all and 0 none, and a harder hit keeps a little less.

settings.name: wall_friction
settings.label: Wall friction
settings.says: How hard a wall rubs on a pollen sliding along it as they touch, as a friction coefficient: the harder the rub, the more of the slide turns into spin.

settings.name: wall_grip
settings.label: Wall grip
settings.says: How much of a pollen's slide and spin along a wall springs back the other way when the bounce grips: 0 leaves it rolling and 1 throws it all back.

settings.name: frame_bounce
settings.label: Frame bounce
settings.says: How much of its speed into the metal frame a pollen keeps as it bounces back, when it hits at 244 in/s: 1 keeps it all and 0 none, and a harder hit keeps a little less.

settings.name: frame_friction
settings.label: Frame friction
settings.says: How hard the metal frame rubs on a pollen sliding along it as they touch, as a friction coefficient: the harder the rub, the more of the slide turns into spin.

settings.name: frame_grip
settings.label: Frame grip
settings.says: How much of a pollen's slide and spin along the metal frame springs back the other way when the bounce grips: 0 leaves it rolling and 1 throws it all back.

settings.name: flower_bounce
settings.label: Flower bounce
settings.says: How much of its speed into a flower a pollen keeps as it bounces back, when it hits at 244 in/s: 1 keeps it all and 0 none, and a harder hit keeps a little less.

settings.name: flower_friction
settings.label: Flower friction
settings.says: How hard a flower rubs on a pollen sliding along it as they touch, as a friction coefficient: the harder the rub, the more of the slide turns into spin.

settings.name: flower_grip
settings.label: Flower grip
settings.says: How much of a pollen's slide and spin along a flower springs back the other way when the bounce grips: 0 leaves it rolling and 1 throws it all back.

settings.name: cell_bounce
settings.label: Cell bounce
settings.says: How much of its speed into a cell a pollen keeps as it bounces back, when it hits at 244 in/s: 1 keeps it all and 0 none, and a harder hit keeps a little less.

settings.name: cell_friction
settings.label: Cell friction
settings.says: How hard a cell rubs on a pollen sliding along it as they touch, as a friction coefficient: the harder the rub, the more of the slide turns into spin.

settings.name: cell_grip
settings.label: Cell grip
settings.says: How much of a pollen's slide and spin along a cell springs back the other way when the bounce grips: 0 leaves it rolling and 1 throws it all back.

settings.name: piece_bounce
settings.label: Ball on ball bounce
settings.says: How much of its speed into another ball a pollen keeps as it bounces back, when it hits at 244 in/s: 1 keeps it all and 0 none, and a harder hit keeps a little less.

settings.name: piece_friction
settings.label: Ball on ball friction
settings.says: How hard another ball rubs on a pollen sliding along it as they touch, as a friction coefficient: the harder the rub, the more of the slide turns into spin.

settings.name: piece_grip
settings.label: Ball on ball grip
settings.says: How much of a pollen's slide and spin along another ball springs back the other way when the bounce grips: 0 leaves it rolling and 1 throws it all back.

settings.name: bounce_loss
settings.label: Bounce loss
settings.says: How much less of its speed a pollen keeps from a bounce for each 100 in/s faster it hits than 244 in/s, and how much more for each 100 in/s slower.

settings.name: bounce_threshold
settings.label: Bounce threshold
settings.says: The slowest a pollen can hit something and still bounce off it; a slower hit settles against it.

settings.name: impact_twist
settings.label: Impact twist
settings.says: How much a bounce slows the pollen's spin about the line to what it hits, like a top's: the lever the rub at the contact works with.

settings.name: spin_twist
settings.label: Spin twist
settings.says: How quickly a pollen resting or rolling on something stops spinning on it like a top: the lever the rub at the contact works with.

settings.name: rolling_resistance
settings.label: Rolling resistance
settings.says: How quickly a rolling pollen slows, as a share of gravity: 0.04 takes about 15 in/s off its speed every second.

settings.name: step
settings.label: Step
settings.says: How much time the simulation moves on at once. A shorter step is more exact and takes more work, and a shot that takes too much work is stopped.

settings.name: longest
settings.label: Longest shot
settings.says: The longest a shot is followed; a pollen still moving then has run out of time.

surfaces.name: floor
surfaces.label: Floor
surfaces.says: The soft foam tiles the field is laid with.

surfaces.name: wall
surfaces.label: Walls
surfaces.says: The perimeter: polycarbonate panels between aluminium rails.

surfaces.name: frame
surfaces.label: Frame
surfaces.says: Metal: the A-frame the hives hang from, and the hives' own tubes, brackets and tag plates.

surfaces.name: flower
surfaces.label: Flowers
surfaces.says: The flowers' HIPS pipes and the plates that hold them.

surfaces.name: cell
surfaces.label: Cells
surfaces.says: The walls and backs of the hives' cells, which a scored ball lands in.

surfaces.name: piece
surfaces.label: Pieces
surfaces.says: Another ball: polyethylene on polyethylene, when the launched pollen meets a piece or two pieces meet.

refused.rule: Pitch is from -30.0 to 90.0 deg, not 95.0
